[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Vitus|Vitus's]] '''holocron''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] made by ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]], Darth Vitus. There was for example information about [[Oricon|location]] of the [[Darth Vitus's labolatory|Vitus's labolatory]]. Long time after his death, a group of Sith found his holocron and set off to find institution.<ref name="BT: TS 5" />
